title: UP Bar Declaration Online Form
organization: Bar Council of Uttar Pradesh / Concerned Authority
postName: UP Advocate Bar Declaration / Enrolment related Online Form
selectionProcess: Online registration / application as per portal process
documentsRequired: Aadhaar, photo ID, mobile number, email, supporting certificates as required
howToApply:
1. Visit official UP Bar Council / declaration portal as notified
2. Login with enrolment / advocate credentials
3. Fill declaration form for the year
4. Upload required documents
5. Submit and download acknowledgement
shortDescription: UP Bar Declaration Online Form – advocates submit annual/required declarations on official Bar Council portal.
content:
UP Bar Declaration online forms are used by enrolled advocates for statutory declarations, renewals or compliance as directed by the Bar Council of Uttar Pradesh / BCI.

Advocates should use only official notices and portals, keep enrolment number ready, and complete submission before the notified last date of each cycle.
